What We Do
Our Scaffolding Services
🏗️

System Scaffolding

Modular and system scaffold solutions for complex construction projects, offering high load capacity and ease of assembly.

🏢

Facade & External Works

Safe and efficient external scaffolding for building facades, painting, cladding, and renovation projects island-wide.

🔧

Tube & Clamp Scaffolding

Flexible traditional scaffolding systems adaptable to any site geometry, from HDB blocks to industrial facilities.

🏭

Industrial Scaffolding

Heavy-duty solutions for industrial, HDB, and commercial projects — factories, plants, and large-scale developments requiring rigorous safety compliance.

🚧

Temporary Structures

Shoring, temporary roofs, and access platforms for events, maintenance, and construction staging areas.

📋

Scaffolding Inspection

Certified scaffold inspections and safety audits compliant with MOM regulations and Singapore Standards.
